explanation in Latvian: *did* + pamatforma: *Did you see it?* *I didn't like it.*

explanation in Latvian: *I / you / we / they*: *do / don't*: *Do your parents live here?*

topic: Present simple

explanation in Latvian: *he / she / it* + darbības vārds ar *-s*: *He goes to work by bus.*

topic: Present simple

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Choose the correct option: She drives very ___.
explanation shown to learner: An adverb says how: adjective + *-ly*: *careful → carefully.*
explanation in Latvian: Apstākļa vārds saka, kā: īpašības vārds + *-ly*: *careful → carefully*.

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Choose the correct option: He speaks Spanish ___.
explanation shown to learner: *good → well*: *He speaks Spanish well.*
explanation in Latvian: *good → well*: *He speaks Spanish well.*

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Choose the correct option: I ___ late for work.
explanation shown to learner: Frequency adverbs go after *be*: *I am never late.*
explanation in Latvian: Biežuma apstākļa vārdi ir aiz *be*: *I am never late.*

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Choose the correct option: You look ___ today.
explanation shown to learner: After *look, feel, seem, sound*: an adjective: *You look tired.*
explanation in Latvian: Aiz *look, feel, seem, sound* ir īpašības vārds: *You look tired.*

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Choose the correct option: The view from the tower was ___ amazing.
explanation shown to learner: Strong adjectives take *absolutely*, not *very*: *absolutely amazing.*
explanation in Latvian: Ar *stipriem* īpašības vārdiem *absolutely*, nevis *very*: *absolutely amazing*.

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Please speak ___. The baby is sleeping. (quiet)
explanation shown to learner: An adverb says how: adjective + *-ly*: *careful → carefully.*
explanation in Latvian: Apstākļa vārds saka, kā: īpašības vārds + *-ly*: *careful → carefully*.

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: He works very ___ every day. (hard)
explanation shown to learner: *hard* has no *-ly* form when it means *with effort*: *He works hard.*
explanation in Latvian: *hard* nozīmē "ar piepūli" un ir bez *-ly*: *He works hard.*

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: I can ___ hear you. Please speak up. (hard)
explanation shown to learner: *hard* = with effort, *hardly* = almost not: *I can hardly hear you.*
explanation in Latvian: *hard* = ar piepūli, *hardly* = gandrīz *nemaz*: *I can hardly hear you.*

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Correct the mistake: She sings very good.
explanation shown to learner: *good → well*: *He speaks Spanish well.*
explanation in Latvian: *good → well*: *He speaks Spanish well.*

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Correct the mistake: I very like this song.
correct answer: I like this song very much. | I really like this song.
explanation shown to learner: *very* cannot describe a verb: *I like it very much.*
explanation in Latvian: Latviski "ļoti patīk", bet angliski *very* viens *pats nevar* aprakstīt darbības vārdu: *I like it very much.*

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Put the words in order.
correct answer: we usually have breakfast at seven
wrong options / checks: also accepted: at seven we usually have breakfast
explanation shown to learner: Frequency adverbs go before the main verb: *We usually have breakfast…*
explanation in Latvian: Biežuma apstākļa vārdi ir pirms pamatdarbības vārda: *We usually have breakfast*…

topic: Adverbs: manner, frequency, degree
task: Put the words in order.
correct answer: she has never been to paris
explanation shown to learner: With two verbs, the adverb goes after the first: *He has never been…*
explanation in Latvian: Ja ir divi darbības vārdi, apstākļa vārds ir aiz pirmā: *He has never been*…

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Choose the correct option: I enjoy ___ in the sea.

explanation in Latvian: *enjoy, finish, mind + -ing*: *I enjoy swimming.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Choose the correct option: We decided ___ a new car.
explanation shown to learner: *want, decide, hope* + *to*: *We decided to buy a car.*
explanation in Latvian: *want, decide, hope + to*: *We decided to buy a car.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Choose the correct option: Do you want ___ with us?
explanation shown to learner: *want, decide, hope* + *to*: *We decided to buy a car.*
explanation in Latvian: *want, decide, hope + to*: *We decided to buy a car.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Choose the correct option: I'm looking forward to ___ you.
explanation shown to learner: After a preposition: *-ing*: *looking forward to seeing, thank you for helping.*
explanation in Latvian: Aiz prievārda: *-ing*: *looking forward to seeing, thank you for helping*.

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Choose the correct option: The film made me ___.
explanation shown to learner: *make / let* + person + base verb: *She made me laugh.*
explanation in Latvian: *make / let* + cilvēks + pamatforma: *She made me laugh.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: He finished ___ the report at six. (write)
explanation shown to learner: *enjoy, finish, mind* + *-ing*: *I enjoy swimming.*
explanation in Latvian: *enjoy, finish, mind + -ing*: *I enjoy swimming.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: I hope ___ you again soon. (see)
explanation shown to learner: *want, decide, hope* + *to*: *We decided to buy a car.*
explanation in Latvian: *want, decide, hope + to*: *We decided to buy a car.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Thank you for ___ me with the boxes. (help)
explanation shown to learner: After a preposition: *-ing*: *looking forward to seeing, thank you for helping.*
explanation in Latvian: Aiz prievārda: *-ing*: *looking forward to seeing, thank you for helping*.

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Would you mind ___ the window? (open)
explanation shown to learner: *enjoy, finish, mind* + *-ing*: *I enjoy swimming.*
explanation in Latvian: *enjoy, finish, mind + -ing*: *I enjoy swimming.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Correct the mistake: I want that you come with me.
correct answer: I want you to come with me.
explanation shown to learner: *want* + person + *to*: *I want you to come.*
explanation in Latvian: Latviski "*gribu*, lai *tu* atnāc", tāpēc *rodas that*, bet angliski *want* + cilvēks + *to*: *I want you to come.*

topic: Verb patterns: -ing or to
task: Correct the mistake: She is good at draw.
explanation shown to learner: After a preposition: *-ing*: *looking forward to seeing, thank you for helping.*
explanation in Latvian: Aiz prievārda: *-ing*: *looking forward to seeing, thank you for helping*.

task: Put the words in order.
correct answer: they decided to stay at home
explanation shown to learner: *want, decide, hope* + *to*: *We decided to buy a car.*
explanation in Latvian: *want, decide, hope + to*: *We decided to buy a car.*

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
task: Choose the correct option: My brother is ___ than me.
explanation shown to learner: Short adjectives: *-er* + *than*: *taller than.*
explanation in Latvian: Īsi īpašības vārdi: *-er + than*: *taller than*.

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
task: Choose the correct option: This is the ___ restaurant in town.
explanation shown to learner: Irregular: *good → better → the best.*
explanation in Latvian: Nekārtni: *good → better → the best*.

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
task: Choose the correct option: Today is ___ than yesterday.
explanation shown to learner: Short adjectives: *-er* + *than*: *taller than.*
explanation in Latvian: Īsi īpašības vārdi: *-er + than*: *taller than*.

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
task: Choose the correct option: This phone is ___ expensive than that one.

explanation in Latvian: *Gari* īpašības vārdi: *more* + īpašības vārds: *more expensive than*.

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as

task: An elephant is ___ than a horse. (big)

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
task: This is the ___ day of the year. (hot)
explanation shown to learner: Superlative: *the* + *-est*: *the hottest day.*
explanation in Latvian: Vispārākā pakāpe: *the + -est*: *the hottest day*.

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
task: My new flat is ___ than the old one. (comfortable)
explanation shown to learner: Long adjectives: *more* + adjective: *more expensive than.*
explanation in Latvian: *Gari* īpašības vārdi: *more* + īpašības vārds: *more expensive than*.

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
task: Your English is getting ___ and ___. (good)

topic: Comparison: -er, more, the most, as ... as
